note: GFP recreation area 5 mi northeast of Selby off US-12/83: a small electric campground in the wooded valley of Hiddenwood Creek, sites 1-6 on a spur and 7-13 on a loop. The lake drained when the 1927 dam washed out in the 2018 flood and has not been restored; hiking trails, playground and picnic shelter. --Claude
